textes.Bienvenue à La Perle du Wok, un restaura: Welcome to La Perle du Wok, a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Dishes, ingredients, orders, customers, waiters and stock: all the restaurant’s data is here. You help its team: Mei, the manager, Lin, the chef, Mehdi, the floor manager, and Agathe, who runs the loyalty program. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par catégorie de la carte : en: One row per category of the menu: starters, wok dishes, specialties, desserts, drinks and set menus.
textes.Une ligne par plat de la carte, boissons: One row per dish on the menu, drinks and set menus included, with its category, its current price and whether it’s available.
textes.Une ligne par ingrédient en réserve, ave: One row per ingredient in storage, with its unit, the quantity in stock and the alert threshold below which it must be restocked.
textes.La recette des plats : une ligne par ing: The dishes’ recipes: one row per ingredient of a dish, with the quantity used for one serving. A dish can have no ingredients recorded.
textes.Une ligne par client qui a un compte, qu: One row per customer with an account, whether or not they’ve ordered yet. Walk-in customers, without an account, aren’t listed.
textes.Une ligne par serveur de l’équipe en sal: One row per waiter on the floor team, with their hire date and their salary.
textes.Une ligne par table du restaurant (là où: One row per restaurant table (where customers sit), with its number, its number of seats and its location.
textes.Une ligne par commande, passée entre le: One row per order, placed between September 1 and November 1, 2024: customer, waiter, table, date, time, party size and status. Its dishes (at least one) are in the order_lines table.
textes.Une ligne par plat d’une commande, avec: One row per dish of an order, with its quantity and the price of one serving. Amount of a line: quantity × unit price; total of an order: the sum of its lines. Cancelled orders keep their lines.
textes.Une ligne par avis : la note, parfois av: One row per review: the rating, sometimes with a comment, that a customer leaves on one of their orders. An order has at most one review.
textes.Nom de la catégorie : « Entrées », « Pla: Name of the category: “Starters”, “Wok dishes”, “Specialties”, “Desserts”, “Drinks” or “Set menus”.
Short description of the category (e.g. “Egg rolls, spring rolls, soups”).

Current price of one serving, in euros.
textes.1 si le plat peut être commandé en ce mo: 1 if the dish can be ordered right now, 0 if it’s unavailable.
textes.Unité dans laquelle l’ingrédient est com: Unit the ingredient is counted in: “kg”, “L” or “piece”.
textes.Quantité en réserve, dans l’unité de l’i: Quantity in storage, in the ingredient’s unit.
textes.Seuil d’alerte, dans l’unité de l’ingréd: Alert threshold, in the ingredient’s unit: when the stock drops below it, it must be restocked.
The dish that contains this ingredient.
The ingredient used in this dish.
textes.Quantité de l’ingrédient pour une portio: Quantity of the ingredient for one serving of the dish, in the ingredient’s unit.
textes.Adresse e-mail du client ; deux clients: Email address of the customer; two customers never have the same one.
textes.Date de création du compte, au format AA: Date the account was created, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Numéro affiché sur la table, différent p: Number shown on the table, different for each table.
Number of seats at the table.
textes.Emplacement de la table : « Salle », « T: Location of the table: “Dining room”, “Terrace” or “Bar”.
textes.Le client qui a passé la commande ; vide: The customer who placed the order; empty (NULL) for a walk-in customer, without an account.
The waiter who took the order.
textes.La table du restaurant où la commande es: The restaurant table where the order is served.
textes.Date de la commande, au format AAAA-MM-J: Date of the order, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Time of the order, in HH:MM format.
textes.Nombre de convives à table pour cette co: Number of guests at the table for this order.
textes.État de la commande : « En cours », « Se: Status of the order: “In progress”, “Served”, “Paid” or “Cancelled”.
The order the line belongs to.
textes.Nombre de portions de ce plat dans la co: Number of servings of this dish in the order.
textes.Prix d’une portion au moment de la comma: Price of one serving at the time of the order, in euros (it can differ from the dish’s current price).
textes.Le client qui a laissé l’avis : celui de: The customer who left the review: the one who placed the rated order.
Rating from 1 to 5, 5 being the best.
textes.Commentaire du client ; vide (NULL) s’il: Customer’s comment; empty (NULL) if they only left a rating.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each dish on the menu, drinks and set menus included, has its price and an availability: 1 when it can be ordered right now, 0 when it’s unavailable. Mehdi, the floor manager, gathers the waiters before opening. He wants to tell them which dishes they won’t be able to offer today, with their price, so they can suggest another dish to a customer who asks for one.
textes.les plats indisponibles en ce moment (di: the dishes unavailable right now (availability at 0)
textes.Un plat qu’on ne peut pas commander port: A dish that can’t be ordered has a 0 in its availability. A single criterion is enough to keep only those.
textes.Quels clients se sont inscrits au second: Which customers signed up in the second half of 2024?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Customers who want to can create an account to join the loyalty program and earn perks; the date their account was created is recorded. Agathe, who runs the program, is preparing a welcome email for new members. She wants to send it to those who created their account during the second half of 2024, from July 1 to December 31.
textes.les clients inscrits entre le 1er juille: the customers who signed up between July 1 and December 31, 2024, both days included
textes.Les dates sont écrites année-mois-jour :: Dates are written year-month-day: they compare like text. You need two bounds, one for the start of the period and one for the end, without forgetting that December 31 is included.
textes.Quels plats composent la catégorie « Pla: Which dishes make up the “Wok dishes” category?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Its menu is split into six sections: starters, wok dishes, specialties, desserts, drinks and set menus. Each dish belongs to a section, but the section’s name isn’t written with the dish: it’s stored separately, with the list of sections. Lin, the chef, is preparing a new chalkboard for the dining room. He wants to present every dish of the “Wok dishes” section on it, from the cheapest to the most expensive, with their price.
textes.les plats de la catégorie « Plats au wok: the dishes in the “Wok dishes” category
textes.Le plat ne connaît sa rubrique que par u: A dish only knows its section by an ID. Fetch the section’s name where it’s written, by linking each dish to its section, then keep only “Wok dishes”, written exactly like that.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. After a meal, a customer with an account can leave a review of their order: a rating from 1 to 5, and sometimes a comment. When they only give a rating, the comment cell stays empty. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, reads each of these reviews. She wants to call back the customers who left a rating without a word of explanation, to understand what they liked or disliked.
textes.l’identifiant du client qui l’a laissé: the ID of the customer who left it
textes.les avis sans commentaire, c’est-à-dire: the reviews without a comment, meaning those whose comment cell is empty (NULL)
textes.par note, de la plus haute à la plus bas: by rating, highest first, then by review ID
textes.Un commentaire absent n’est pas un texte: A missing comment isn’t an empty text: it’s an empty cell, with no value at all. You can’t compare it with an equals sign; there’s a separate way to ask whether a cell is empty.
textes.Quels serveurs ont été embauchés après l: Which waiters were hired after January 1, 2020?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. On the floor, a team of waiters takes the orders, and each one’s hire date is recorded. Mehdi, the floor manager, is organizing mentoring for newcomers: an experienced waiter shadows each recently hired waiter during their first shifts. He wants to review the waiters hired after January 1, 2020, that day excluded, with the date they started.
textes.les serveurs embauchés après le 1er janv: the waiters hired after January 1, 2020, that day excluded
textes.Les dates écrites année-mois-jour se com: Dates written year-month-day compare like text. “After” means strictly later: January 1, 2020 itself must not come out.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order is recorded with its date, its time and its status: “In progress” during the meal, “Served”, then “Paid”, or “Cancelled”. Mei, the manager, wants to talk about it with the team at the next meeting. She wants to review every cancelled order, with the date and time it was placed, to see whether they fall at rush hours.
textes.Le statut est un texte : compare-le exac: The status is text: compare it exactly with “Cancelled”, capital letter and double “l” included. A single wrong letter and no order comes out.
textes.Quels ingrédients sont sous le seuil d’a: Which ingredients are below the alert threshold?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each ingredient in storage has a stock (counted in kilos, liters or pieces) and an alert threshold: when the stock drops below it, more must be bought before running out. Lin, the chef, is calling his supplier tomorrow morning. Before that, he wants to know which ingredients have dropped below their alert threshold, and by how much, to order them right away.
textes.les ingrédients dont le stock est strict: the ingredients whose stock is strictly below the alert threshold
textes.par quantité manquante (le seuil d’alert: by missing quantity (the alert threshold minus the stock), smallest first, then by name
textes.Ici, la condition compare deux informati: Here, the condition compares two pieces of information from the same row: the stock and the alert threshold. To sort the ingredients, you can also calculate the gap between the two.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Customers can create an account for the loyalty program, even before eating at the restaurant. Their orders are stored separately, each with the customer who placed it, or without a customer for a walk-in. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, wants to reach out to the members who haven’t placed any order yet, not even a cancelled one: she’ll email them a welcome offer.
textes.les clients qui n’ont passé aucune comma: the customers who haven’t placed any order, not even a cancelled one
textes.Pars de tous les clients et regarde, pou: Start from every customer and check, for each one, whether there’s at least one order in their name. Those with no order found are the ones to reach out to. Watch out for orders without a customer: they mustn’t skew the comparison.
textes.Quels serveurs n’ont jamais pris de comm: Which waiters have never taken an order?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order is taken by a waiter of the floor team, and the order keeps that waiter’s name. The newest arrivals sometimes haven’t taken any order yet. Mehdi, the floor manager, is preparing the week’s schedule: he wants to pair the waiters who haven’t taken any order yet, not even a cancelled one, with an experienced colleague.
textes.les serveurs qui n’ont pris aucune comma: the waiters who haven’t taken any order, not even a cancelled one
textes.Pars de tous les serveurs et cherche, po: Start from every waiter and look, for each one, for the orders they took. Keep every waiter, even those for whom nothing is found, then keep only those left without an order.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Some customers have a loyalty account: they’re recorded in the database. The others are walk-in customers, without an account. After an order, a customer with an account can leave a review, only once: a rating, sometimes with a comment. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, finds that customers leave too few reviews. She wants to spot every order that hasn’t received one, whatever it is: even a cancelled order, even a walk-in customer’s.
textes.les commandes qui n’ont reçu aucun avis,: the orders that haven’t received any review, including the cancelled ones and those of walk-in customers
textes.par date, puis par identifiant de la com: by date, then by order ID
textes.Une commande sans avis n’a aucune ligne: An order without a review has no matching row among the reviews. Keep every order, even those with no match, then keep only those left on their own.
textes.Combien rapporte chaque catégorie de la: How much does each menu category bring in?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Its menu is split into six sections: starters, wok dishes, specialties, desserts, drinks and set menus. An order can contain several dishes: each dish ordered makes a line, with the number of servings and the price of one serving that day. Mei, the manager, is reviewing her menu. She wants to compare what each section brings in, without counting cancelled orders, to know which ones to highlight.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the amounts (quantity × unit price) of the order lines of its dishes
textes.toutes les commandes sauf celles au stat: every order except those with the status “Cancelled”
textes.Le montant d’une ligne vaut le nombre de: The amount of a line is the number of servings multiplied by the price of one serving. To get to the section, you need to go through the order (for its status), then through the dish. First leave out the cancelled ones, then add up the amounts section by section.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order is taken by a waiter of the floor team, and the order keeps that waiter’s name. Recently hired waiters sometimes haven’t taken any. Mehdi, the floor manager, is balancing the schedule for the coming weeks. He wants to compare the number of orders taken by each waiter, cancelled ones included, without forgetting those who haven’t taken any and must appear with 0.
textes.le nombre de commandes qu’il a prises, a: the number of orders they took, cancelled ones included, 0 if they took none
textes.tous les serveurs, y compris ceux qui n’: every waiter, including those who haven’t taken any order
textes.par nombre de commandes, du plus grand a: by number of orders, largest first, then by last name
textes.Pars de tous les serveurs, même ceux san: Start from every waiter, even those without an order, then count their orders. Careful: counting the rows would give 1 to a waiter without an order. Count the orders actually found instead.
textes.Quel est le panier moyen par client ?: What is the average basket per customer?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. An order brings together several dishes: each dish ordered makes a line, with a number of servings and a price per serving. The order total is the sum of its lines. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, is preparing new offers. She wants to know how much each customer with an account spends on average per visit, without counting cancelled orders.
textes.son panier moyen : la moyenne des totaux: their average basket: the average of their order totals, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les clients qui ont au moins u: only the customers with at least one of these orders
textes.par panier moyen, du plus élevé au plus: by average basket, highest first, then by last name
textes.Le total d’une commande est la somme de: An order’s total is the sum of its lines: quantity × unit price.
textes.La moyenne porte sur une valeur par comm: The average is over one value per order, not one value per order line.
textes.Deux étapes : calcule d’abord le total d: Two steps: first calculate the total of each order, then average these totals for each customer. An average taken directly over the lines would give the average price of a line, not of a visit.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order lists its dishes line by line: the number of servings served and the price of one serving that day. Lin, the chef, is planning his ingredient purchases for next month. He wants to know the 5 dishes the kitchen serves the most servings of, and what they bring in, without counting cancelled orders, so he never runs out of what he needs to make them.
textes.le nombre de portions vendues : la somme: the number of servings sold: the sum of the quantities of its order lines
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the amounts (quantity × unit price) of these same lines
textes.seulement les 5 premiers plats de ce tri: only the first 5 dishes of this sort
textes.par nombre de portions vendues, du plus: by number of servings sold, largest first
textes.Pour chaque plat, additionne les portion: For each dish, add up the servings of its lines: counting the lines isn’t enough, a line can hold several servings. Then sort the dishes and keep only the first five.
textes.Quels clients ont dépensé plus de 100 €: Which customers have spent more than €100?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. The orders of customers with an account are recorded in their name. Each order lists its dishes line by line, with a number of servings and a price per serving. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, is organizing a tasting evening. She wants to invite the customers who have spent more than €100 at the restaurant in total, without counting cancelled orders.
textes.son total dépensé : la somme des montant: their total spent: the sum of the amounts (quantity × unit price) of the lines of their orders
textes.seulement les clients dont ce total dépa: only the customers whose total is strictly above €100
textes.par total dépensé, du plus élevé au plus: by total spent, highest first, then by last name
textes.Calcule d’abord le total dépensé par cha: First calculate the total spent by each customer, leaving out the cancelled orders. The €100 threshold applies to that total: it can only be checked once the sums are done, not line by line.
textes.Quels ingrédients entrent dans plus de 3: Which ingredients go into more than 3 dishes?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each dish has its recipe: the list of ingredients needed for one serving. The same ingredient can go into several recipes. Lin, the chef, wants to spot his most versatile ingredients, the ones that go into the recipe of more than 3 dishes: the kitchen must never run out of them.
textes.le nombre de plats différents dont la re: the number of different dishes whose recipe uses it
textes.seulement les ingrédients utilisés dans: only the ingredients used in more than 3 dishes (so at least 4)
textes.par nombre de plats, du plus grand au pl: by number of dishes, largest first
textes.Les recettes relient chaque ingrédient a: The recipes link each ingredient to the dishes that use it. Count, for each ingredient, the number of different dishes, then keep only the ingredients above 3: this threshold applies to the count, once it’s done.
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. An order’s bill is calculated dish by dish: the number of servings multiplied by the price of one serving, then added up. Some orders come from walk-in customers, without an account: they have no customer. Mei, the manager, wants to see which tables spend the most. She wants to review the bills over €50, including those of walk-in customers, which will be shown under the name “Anonymous”.
textes.le prénom du client, ou « Anonyme » pour: the customer’s first name, or “Anonymous” for a walk-in customer (without an account)
textes.le nom du client, ou un texte vide pour: the customer’s last name, or an empty text for a walk-in customer (no characters, not a NULL cell)
textes.le total de la commande : la somme de se: the order total: the sum of its lines (quantity × unit price)
textes.toutes les commandes sauf celles au stat: every order except those with the status “Cancelled”, walk-in customers included
textes.seulement les commandes dont le total dé: only the orders whose total is strictly above €50
textes.par total, du plus élevé au plus bas, pu: by total, highest first, then by order ID
textes.Calcule d’abord le total de chaque comma: First calculate the total of each order. Then, when you fetch the customer, also keep the orders that have none, and replace their missing name with “Anonymous” and with an empty text.
textes.Quels clients commandent dans au moins 3: Which customers order from at least 3 categories?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Its menu is split into six sections: starters, wok dishes, specialties, desserts, drinks and set menus. Each order lists its dishes, and each dish belongs to a section. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, is looking for curious customers, those who order from at least 3 different sections, without counting cancelled orders. She’ll let them taste the new dishes before anyone else.
textes.le nombre de catégories différentes dans: the number of different categories they ordered from
textes.seulement les clients qui ont commandé d: only the customers who ordered from at least 3 different categories
textes.par nombre de catégories, du plus grand: by number of categories, largest first, then by last name
textes.Pour chaque client, passe de ses command: For each customer, go from their orders to the dishes, then to the sections. Count the different sections, without counting the same one twice, and keep only the customers with at least 3.
textes.Comment se répartissent les notes des av: How are the review ratings distributed?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. After a meal, a customer with an account can rate their order from 1 to 5, 5 being the best rating, and add a comment if they want. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program and reads all these reviews, is preparing her end-of-month report for the team. She wants to see how many reviews each rating received, and what share of all reviews it represents, as a percentage.
textes.le nombre d’avis qui ont cette note: the number of reviews with this rating
textes.la part de ces avis parmi tous les avis,: the share of these reviews among all reviews, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les notes qui ont reçu au moin: only the ratings that received at least one review
textes.Compte les avis note par note. Pour la p: Count the reviews rating by rating. For the share, you also need the total number of reviews, all combined: divide the first by the second. Careful, a division between two whole numbers loses the decimals: bring a decimal number into the calculation.
textes.Quels plats n’ont jamais été commandés ?: Which dishes have never been ordered?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order lists the dishes served, but some dishes on the menu don’t appear in any order, or only in cancelled orders: nobody has really taken to them. Lin, the chef, is about to have the new menu printed. Before that, he’s thinking of removing these dishes, whether available or not, and wants to see them with their section and their price.
textes.les plats qui ne figurent dans aucune co: the dishes that don’t appear in any order, available or not
textes.par nom de catégorie, puis par nom du pl: by category name, then by dish name
textes.Une commande au statut « Annulée » ne co: An order with the status “Cancelled” doesn’t count: a dish found only in cancelled orders is kept.
textes.Pour chaque plat, demande-toi s’il exist: For each dish, ask yourself whether there’s at least one non-cancelled order that contains it. Keep only the dishes where the answer is no. To read the status, you need to go through each line’s order.
textes.Quels sont les 3 serveurs qui rapportent: Which 3 waiters bring in the most?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order is taken by a waiter, and its total is the sum of its dishes: the number of servings multiplied by the price of one serving. Mei, the manager, wants to give a bonus to the 3 waiters whose orders bring in the most for the restaurant. She doesn’t count cancelled orders, which brought in nothing.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: their revenue: the sum of the amounts (quantity × unit price) of the lines of the orders they took
textes.seulement les 3 premiers serveurs de ce: only the first 3 waiters of this sort
textes.Le chiffre d’affaires d’un serveur passe: A waiter’s revenue goes through their orders, then through the dishes of each one. Leave out the cancelled ones before adding up waiter by waiter, then sort them and keep only the first three.
textes.Comment se classent les clients selon le: How do the customers rank by spending?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Customers with an account build up their spending order after order, cancelled orders aside. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, is preparing a tiered card: the more a customer spends, the bigger their perks. To set these tiers, she wants to rank the customers by what they’ve spent at the restaurant, from the biggest total to the smallest, with their rank.
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus gros total, le: their rank: 1 for the biggest total, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.par rang, puis par nom: by rank, then by last name

textes.Comment évoluent les commandes de Camill: How are Camille Moreau’s orders changing?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order of a customer with an account is recorded in their name, with its date and its dishes. Camille Moreau is the customer who comes back most often. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, wants to follow what she spends from one visit to the next: for each non-cancelled order, the total, that of the previous visit, and the difference between the two.
textes.son total : la somme de ses lignes (quan: its total: the sum of its lines (quantity × unit price)
textes.le total de la commande précédente, case: the total of the previous order, an empty cell (NULL) for the first one
textes.l’écart : le total moins le total précéd: the difference: the total minus the previous total, an empty cell (NULL) for the first one
textes.les commandes de la cliente Camille More: the orders of the customer Camille Moreau, except those with the status “Cancelled”
textes.La commande précédente est celle de Cami: The previous order is Camille Moreau’s order that comes just before, by date then by ID.
textes.Calcule d’abord le total de chaque comma: First calculate the total of each order. Then, on each row, you need the total of the order just before: a function can read the previous row. Only let it work on Camille Moreau’s orders, otherwise it would fetch another customer’s.
textes.Quels clients dépensent plus que la moye: Which customers spend more than average?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Customers with an account don’t all spend the same: some come often, others only once. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, wants to know which customers spend more than the average customer, and by how much, without counting cancelled orders. textes.son écart à la moyenne : son total moins: their gap from the average: their total minus the average of the customers’ totals, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les clients dont le total dépa: only the customers whose total is strictly above this average
textes.La moyenne porte sur un total par client: The average is over one total per customer, without the customers who have none of these orders.
textes.Deux étapes : le total de chaque client,: Two steps: each customer’s total, then the average of these totals, a single value for the whole restaurant. Put that value next to each customer to compare and calculate the gap.
textes.Comment se classent les plats au sein de: How do the dishes rank within their category?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Its menu is split into six sections, from starters to set menus, and each dish belongs to a section. Comparing a dessert with a wok dish doesn’t make much sense. So Lin, the chef, is reviewing his menu section by section: he wants to rank the dishes by what they bring in, against the other dishes of the same section, without counting cancelled orders.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the amounts (quantity × unit price) of its order lines
textes.son rang dans sa catégorie : 1 pour le p: its rank in its category: 1 for the biggest revenue, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.seulement les plats vendus au moins une: only the dishes sold at least once in these orders
textes.par nom de catégorie, puis par rang, pui: by category name, then by rank, then by dish name
textes.Calcule d’abord ce que rapporte chaque p: First calculate what each dish brings in. The ranking must then start again from 1 in each section: the rank is given within each section, not over the whole menu.
textes.Quels clients commandent sur au moins 3: Which customers order in at least 3 different months?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order is dated, and those of customers with an account are recorded in their name. Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, wants to thank the customers who came back month after month in 2024: those who ordered in at least 3 different months of the year, without counting cancelled orders.
textes.le nombre de mois différents où il a com: the number of different months they ordered in
textes.les commandes passées en 2024, sauf cell: the orders placed in 2024, except those with the status “Cancelled”
textes.seulement les clients qui ont commandé d: only the customers who ordered in at least 3 different months
textes.Ne garde que les commandes de 2024 non a: Keep only the non-cancelled orders of 2024. For each customer, you need to count the different months of their orders: extract the month from each date, then count the months without duplicates. The threshold applies to that count.
textes.Quels plats dépassent la moyenne de leur: Which dishes are above their category’s average?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Its menu is split into six sections, and each dish belongs to a section. Lin, the chef, plans his ingredient purchases section by section. He wants to spot the dishes that sell better than their section’s average, in number of servings served, without counting cancelled orders, so he never runs out of what he needs to make them.
textes.son nombre de portions vendues : la somm: its number of servings sold: the sum of the quantities of its order lines
textes.la moyenne de sa catégorie : la moyenne: its category’s average: the average of the servings sold of its dishes, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les plats dont ce nombre dépas: only the dishes whose number is strictly above their category’s average
textes.par nom de catégorie, puis par nombre de: by category name, then by number of servings sold, largest first
textes.Un plat jamais vendu n’entre pas dans la: A dish never sold doesn’t go into its category’s average, not even as 0.
textes.Deux étapes : les portions vendues de ch: Two steps: the servings sold of each dish, then the average of these servings in each section. Link each dish to its own section’s average to compare.
textes.Quel est le classement des serveurs par: How do the waiters rank by revenue?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each waiter takes orders on the floor, and some have just arrived and don’t have any yet. For the annual reviews, Mei, the manager, wants to rank the whole floor team by what each one brings in, without counting cancelled orders. The newcomers must appear in the ranking, with €0.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: their revenue: the sum of the amounts (quantity × unit price) of the lines of their orders, 0 if they have none
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus gros chiffre d: their rank: 1 for the biggest revenue, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.tous les serveurs, y compris ceux qui n’: every waiter, including those who have none of these orders
textes.Pars de tous les serveurs, même ceux san: Start from every waiter, even those without an order. The condition on cancelled orders must not make them disappear: put it where you link the orders, not in the final filter. An empty total becomes 0, then gives the rank.
textes.Qui reprend le même plat dans plus de 2: Who orders the same dish in more than 2 orders?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each order of a customer with an account is recorded in their name, with the list of its dishes. Some regulars always order the same dish. Lin, the chef, wants to thank these loyal customers: those who ordered the same dish in more than 2 non-cancelled orders. He’ll have a little something for them on their next visit.
textes.le nombre de commandes différentes de ce: the number of different orders of this customer that contain this dish
textes.seulement les couples client-plat présen: only the customer-dish pairs found in more than 2 orders (so at least 3)
textes.par nombre de commandes, du plus grand a: by number of orders, largest first, then by customer last name
textes.Il faut former des couples client et pla: You need to form customer and dish pairs, then count how many different orders each pair appears in. It’s that number of orders, not the number of servings, that must be above 2.
textes.Qui dépense plus que la moyenne de son s: Who spends more than the average for their email suffix?
textes.La Perle du Wok est un restaurant chinoi: La Perle du Wok is a Chinese restaurant specializing in wok cooking. Each customer with an account gave their email address, which often ends with their country code: “fr”, “de”… Agathe, who runs the loyalty program, wants to compare each customer with those whose address ends with the same two letters. She’s looking for those who spend more than their group’s average, without counting cancelled orders.
textes.le suffixe de l’e-mail du client : ses 2: the suffix of the customer’s email: its last 2 characters (for example “fr”)
textes.la moyenne des totaux des clients de ce: the average of the totals of the customers with this suffix, rounded to two decimal places
textes.par suffixe, puis par total dépensé, du: by suffix, then by total spent, highest first
textes.Un client sans aucune de ces commandes n: A customer without any of these orders doesn’t count in the average.
textes.Calcule le total de chaque client et les: Calculate each customer’s total and the last two letters of their address. Then average the totals for each address ending, and compare each customer with their group’s average.
